properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for preparing and test incident response plan
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to ensure continuous monitoring and alerting to detect incidents promptly. Maintain a documented incident response plan defining roles, responsibilities, and escalation paths. Establish clear communication channels for rapid coordination. Ensure trained personnel and resources are available 24/7. Use automated workflows for containment and triage. Conduct regular exercises to validate readiness.
